camera.position: Prop the iPhone upright at face height, about an arm's length away, front camera facing you with face and jaw visible.

title: Talking While Eating
summary: Chew and talk in the same take, as happens at real meals.
purpose: Collect chewing mixed with speech and speech without chewing so the motion detector learns to separate them.

request.summary: Talking and chewing move the jaw together at meals; no recording contains both.

preparation: Wear both AirPods and confirm they are connected to this iPhone.
Prop the iPhone so your face and jaw are visible.
Use steady, even lighting on your face.
Stay within the camera view for the whole recording.
Prepare a few bites of an easy-to-chew food. Speak at a normal volume about anything.

activities.instruction: Look at the camera and nod distinctly
activities.expected_behavior: One clear nod visible in video and AirPods motion; mouth still

activities.instruction: Take a bite and chew without talking
Keep chewing and talk between chews
Swallow, then keep talking without chewing
activities.expected_behavior: Speech only, no food in mouth

activities.instruction: Take another bite and chew while listening

activities.expected_behavior: One clear nod visible in video and AirPods motion; mouth still
